name: Agent Skills Discovery RFC
summary: Cloudflare's draft for publishing Agent Skills at /.well-known/agent-skills/, with an index.json listing each skill and a SHA-256 digest.
description: Draft v0.2.0 (published 2026-01-17, updated 2026-03-12). v0.2.0 renamed the path from /.well-known/skills/ to /.well-known/agent-skills/, identifies the index schema by $schema (https://schemas.agentskills.io/discovery/0.2.0/schema.json), and gives each entry a type (skill-md or archive), url and digest. Clients load names and descriptions first and fetch skills on demand; they SHALL NOT execute bundled scripts by default. Not backward-compatible with v0.1.0. Apache-2.0.
